title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-24

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a jam‑heavy hour‑limited set featuring an extended New Potato.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers gave the recording five stars, praising the extended, sweet version of New Potato and the overall jam‑oriented performance. The soundboard source is described as clear with no technical flaws, though the one‑hour venue limit forced shorter songs toward the end of the set.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviews are uniformly positive and rate the show and recording at five stars, but only two reviews limit confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about sound; reviewers imply a clean, clear capture typical of a good sbd source.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The one‑hour set limit at the Avalon led the band to shorten later tunes, but overall the set stayed jam‑focused and energetic.
